note: Published family recipes, copied from the private recipes/recipes.json after the family approved them for the demo (Nov 2026). Quantities are restaurant batch sizes, as written.

recipes.title: Greens
ingredients: 2 Bags Chopped Swiss chard or Rapini
steps: - Bring large stock pot 3/4's full of water to a boil. Add Escarole and Greens and cook till escarole is soft – approx 10-12minutes – Drain, shock with cold water. Press and drain in colander using a small pizza pan with a 5 gallon bucket of water on top for at least 1/2 an hour. Then add spices and oils.
recipes.blurb: The base of our Beans & Greens and the Steak Giacobbi. It started as a Carmine's sheet: someone crossed out "Carmines," wrote in "Giacobbi's," and swapped the frozen collards for Swiss chard or rapini.

recipes.title: Pasta Fazool
ingredients: 1 lb Bacon … Diced and well browned
steps: - Use the the large 8 gal pot. Add water, base, spices & cut veg to stock pot. Bring to boil. Then add the can of Marinara & boil again. Next add 2 & 1/2 cans of Great Northern beans. Still well – & often!
* While you are boiling the stock & veg take the bacon and brown in a large sauté pan. Brown to crisp and add sherry, smoke and marinara. Puree this mix with other 1/2 can of Great Northern Beans.
When soup is almost done add this bean paste mix to thicken the soup. Still well. Add parmesan and stir. Turn down the burner & simmer for 40 min.
When done – stir well and divide into 5 or 6 buckets and chill.
recipes.blurb: On today's menu as Pasta e Fagiole, marked "family recipe." The kitchen makes it four gallons at a time.

recipes.title: Meat Balls (10 Pound Batch)
steps: - Pull meat ahead of time and put into bus pan and let come close to room temp.(Makes Mixing Easier). Sautee garlic and onion until clear. Mix all ingredients and meat together until COMPLETELY combined. Roll meatballs into 5 oz smooth balls. Put 4x7 in hotel pans, foil covered, with an inch of water in pan in regular ovens at 400 degrees for 45 minutes. Drain and allow to cool. For larger batches do multiple 20 pound mixes.
recipes.blurb: The ten-pound batch. For a busy weekend, the card says to do several twenty-pound mixes.

recipes.title: Short Rib Meatballs
steps: Mince onion & carrot together w/ Port & sautee
Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl and then portion into 4.5 oz balls
bake uncovered for 30- 40 minutes in 2" hotels pans with 1/2 inch of water
when out of oven drain water off and cool rapidly
recipes.blurb: A Carmine's card with the kitchen's edits still on it: more panko, bigger meatballs, and "cut in half" scrawled next to the yield.

recipes.title: Cannoli Mix
steps: -Add all ingredients to mixer and mix on 1st speed for 3-4 minutes.
recipes.blurb: Red-label ricotta only. Somewhere along the way the sugar came down to 3/4 cup and the chips went mini.
